title: Conservation Agriculture & Soil Health
description: Practices to preserve soil moisture, reduce erosion, and enhance organic matter.
keyPoints: Minimum soil disturbance (ripping instead of deep ploughing)
Permanent organic soil cover using crop residues

title: Rainwater Harvesting & Irrigation Efficiency
description: Techniques for capturing and storing rainwater during dry spells.
keyPoints: Constructing infiltration pits and tied ridges
Using mulching to drastically reduce soil evaporation
Scheduling irrigation during cooler morning or evening hours
